Plan & facilitate community-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.

after-school programs or educational settings for youth
programs, activities, and special events for senior citizens

Position Overview

The KU School of Professional Studies (SPS) was created in 2019 with a vision to transform students’ lives and improve communities through innovative, student-focused, and exemplary academic programs that lead to rewarding careers in an array of fields that serve the workforce needs of Kansas and beyond. The school offers a variety of disciplines, course formats, class schedules, student services, aid, and more to meet the needs of a wide range of students who may work full-time, have considerable commitments outside of the classroom, have prior college-level education, or otherwise need a different approach to earning academic credentials. The School continues to launch new degree programs aimed at supporting the needs of future students and is poised for significant growth over the next five years.

The Center for Workplace Excellence is part of the KU School of Professional Studies and supported by the Johnson County Education Research Triangle (JCERT). With the goal of maximizing individual and organizational potential, the Center helps the local workforce strengthen professional skills, boost employee engagement, and promote enhanced leadership training and coaching.

The Center enhances the operational efficiency of the workforce by offering:

On-Demand Workshops: Timely, expert-led training that delivers practical insights and tools for today’s most pressing and emerging challenges. Informed by feedback, the Center designs learning that directly addresses the issues organizations are facing today and that is based on the most recent research.
Ongoing Workshop Series: Ongoing, reliable training options that give organizations consistent support, building capability over time, and helping achieve training and development goals. These are the courses that operate on a consistent schedule.
Customized Professional Development: Tailored, research-backed learning experiences that help individuals and teams build skills they can use today. Through facilitated workshops and team trainings, the Center adapts proven expertise to fit organizational goals.
Organizational Consulting: Faculty and staff works alongside leaders and teams to tackle complex challenges by clarifying priorities, aligning people and resources, and turning strategy into action. The approach is practical, collaborative, and tailored.
Executive Coaching: The Center offers an Executive Coaching Connection that envisions a dynamic future where leaders thrive, organizations flourish, and communities benefit.

KU offers great benefits to employees with up to 176 hours of paid vacation per year, 96 hours of sick leave earned per year, nine paid holidays plus one discretionary day, a retirement program, medical & dental insurance, life and disability insurance, other benefit plan options, and State of Kansas discounts offered by various vendors. KU also offers employees educational and professional development opportunities. Tuition assistance offers up to 12 credit hours per year for employees and Employee Dependent Tuition Assistance Scholarship (EDTAS) award opportunities! Details available at: https://humanresources.ku.edu/tuition-assistance.

KU’s excellence is a result of the rich tapestry of experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds of our faculty, staff, students, and colleagues from across our nation and the globe. At KU, we invest in continuous learning and growth by creating a climate where people engage in respectful dialogue and debate and support each other’s success. We foster a culture of care where each person is seen, heard, and valued. When people feel a true sense of belonging, we believe they are better able to reach their full potential and achieve remarkable things.

Job Description

The Education Program Manager manages all support mechanisms relating to the design, delivery, and performance of professional education and workforce development programs for the Center. This role is responsible for ensuring a portfolio of programs are monitored and tracked from concept through execution, ensuring alignment with market demand, organizational strategy, and revenue goals. The position works cross-functionally with faculty, partners, and clients.

Execute marketing plans for the Center programs and offerings.
Draft and format marketing materials, including program descriptions, promotional emails, and social media content.
Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies to achieve enrollment and revenue targets
Produce marketing materials including social media images, website graphics, and promotional flyers.
Maintain a marketing calendar outlining promotional activities, timelines, and outreach schedules.
Oversee development of marketing assets and messaging aligned to target audiences.
Maintain enrollment tracking (HubSpot) mechanisms for upcoming programs and workshops.
Assist with collecting testimonials, participant feedback, and program success stories for marketing use.
Coordinate communication with registrants including confirmation messages, reminders, and follow-up materials – HubSpot.
Support post-program communications including participant surveys and follow-up engagement opportunities.

30% - Program Management and Delivery

Manage the full lifecycle of professional education programs from design through evaluation, including space logistics, technology needs, and participant communications.
Prepare scopes of work, timelines, and deliverable summaries for professional education and consulting projects.
Maintain the Center’s customer relationship management (CRM) system, including data entry and contact management.
Maintain and update website content related to Center offerings.

25% - Program and Business Development

Lead development of proposals for professional education programs, consulting engagements, and workforce initiatives.
Compile background research, data, and organizational information required for proposal development.

Conduct market analysis to identify new program opportunities and revenue streams.
Develop scopes of work, pricing models, and program structures aligned with CWE strategy.
Track and manage pipeline of opportunities and revenue projections.

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

The seniors residing at Silvey Villas live independently. The goal of this way of life is to maximize a resident’s dignity, autonomy, privacy, independence, choice, and safety. Residents are assisted in obtaining the services they need to maintain independence and the highest possible quality of life. We strive to keep residents as active and involved as possible through educational, social and recreational programs. The seniors are responsible for their own housing, meals, housekeeping, laundry, and personal care.

What You'll Do

Program Manager

Chicago, Illinois, United States

Please note this is for Chicago, Illinois, United States. You only need to apply to one location if there are multiple listed for the job.

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Position Summary

At Ripple Treasury, we empower finance and treasury teams around the world to work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence. Our cloud-based treasury and risk management platform helps organizations gain real-time access to their cash, liquidity, and risk positions, enabling better decisions and stronger financial outcomes. We believe in delivering not just software, but transformative solutions that make a measurable difference for our clients.

We are seeking a Program Manager to guide the implementation of various client solutions throughout the Americas. In this role at Ripple Treasury, you will connect detailed project activities with communication to executive collaborators. You will maintain the overall health of programs spanning multiple engagements, foster governance and responsibility, and guarantee clients achieve the full value of Ripple Treasury’s platform on time and within budget.

This role requires a practitioner who can work at both the program and project levels. You will translate strategic objectives into structured delivery plans and manage cross-functional dependencies. You will also raise issues proactively when risks appear. Additionally, you will play a key role in mentoring and developing the broader PMO team.

What You Will Do

Own program-level delivery across a portfolio of concurrent Ripple Treasury implementations, ensuring coordinated progress across multiple solutions, teams, and client partners.
Serve as the senior point of contact for client program sponsors and executive collaborators, developing positive relationships and maintaining alignment on scope, timelines, and business outcomes.
Develop and maintain coordinated program plans, resource allocations, RAID logs, and program-level reporting in accordance with Ripple Treasury’s delivery standards.
Identify and manage cross-project dependencies, risks, and customer concerns; drive issue resolution across internal and external teams with urgency and ownership.
Facilitate executive-level status updates, steering committee meetings, and post-implementation reviews with clients and internal leadership.
Partner with Project Managers on individual engagements, providing mentorship, quality oversight, and support for blocking issues as needed.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Consulting, Sales, and Customer Success to align delivery execution with client objectives and company priorities.
Champion program governance guidelines, change management, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.
Contribute to PMO capability-building, including playbook development, methodology refinement, and team mentoring, as the practice scales.

Who We Are Looking For

5+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 2 years managing enterprise-level SaaS, enterprise software, or professional services implementations.
Proven ability to manage complex, multi-solution programs simultaneously, often with remote resources, global teams, and partner-led delivery components.
Strong collaborator management skills, with the ability to navigate and influence at all organizational levels, from project teams to C-suite sponsors.
Experience working across internal delivery teams and third-party partners, including Systems Integrators (SIs) or global consulting firms.
Solid understanding of treasury, cash management, or financial risk management processes; experience with Ripple Treasury (GTreasury), Kyriba, ION, or similar platforms is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to identify, bring up, and drive resolution of program risks and issues in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
Outstanding written and spoken expression abilities, with the capacity to simplify complex delivery updates into clear executive summaries.
Ability to mentor and develop junior PMs and consultants while managing your own program delivery load.

For positions that will be based in IL, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.

IL Annual Base Salary Range

$132,000—$165,000 USD

Who We Are

Do Your Best Work

The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

new_jobs.description:
Position Overview

The KU School of Professional Studies (SPS) was created in 2019 with a vision to transform students’ lives and improve communities through innovative, student-focused, and exemplary academic programs that lead to rewarding careers in an array of fields that serve the workforce needs of Kansas and beyond. The school offers a variety of disciplines, course formats, class schedules, student services, aid, and more to meet the needs of a wide range of students who may work full-time, have considerable commitments outside of the classroom, have prior college-level education, or otherwise need a different approach to earning academic credentials. The School continues to launch new degree programs aimed at supporting the needs of future students and is poised for significant growth over the next five years.

The Center for Workplace Excellence is part of the KU School of Professional Studies and supported by the Johnson County Education Research Triangle (JCERT). With the goal of maximizing individual and organizational potential, the Center helps the local workforce strengthen professional skills, boost employee engagement, and promote enhanced leadership training and coaching.

The Center enhances the operational efficiency of the workforce by offering:

On-Demand Workshops: Timely, expert-led training that delivers practical insights and tools for today’s most pressing and emerging challenges. Informed by feedback, the Center designs learning that directly addresses the issues organizations are facing today and that is based on the most recent research.
Ongoing Workshop Series: Ongoing, reliable training options that give organizations consistent support, building capability over time, and helping achieve training and development goals. These are the courses that operate on a consistent schedule.
Customized Professional Development: Tailored, research-backed learning experiences that help individuals and teams build skills they can use today. Through facilitated workshops and team trainings, the Center adapts proven expertise to fit organizational goals.
Organizational Consulting: Faculty and staff works alongside leaders and teams to tackle complex challenges by clarifying priorities, aligning people and resources, and turning strategy into action. The approach is practical, collaborative, and tailored.
Executive Coaching: The Center offers an Executive Coaching Connection that envisions a dynamic future where leaders thrive, organizations flourish, and communities benefit.

KU offers great benefits to employees with up to 176 hours of paid vacation per year, 96 hours of sick leave earned per year, nine paid holidays plus one discretionary day, a retirement program, medical & dental insurance, life and disability insurance, other benefit plan options, and State of Kansas discounts offered by various vendors. KU also offers employees educational and professional development opportunities. Tuition assistance offers up to 12 credit hours per year for employees and Employee Dependent Tuition Assistance Scholarship (EDTAS) award opportunities! Details available at: https://humanresources.ku.edu/tuition-assistance.

KU’s excellence is a result of the rich tapestry of experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds of our faculty, staff, students, and colleagues from across our nation and the globe. At KU, we invest in continuous learning and growth by creating a climate where people engage in respectful dialogue and debate and support each other’s success. We foster a culture of care where each person is seen, heard, and valued. When people feel a true sense of belonging, we believe they are better able to reach their full potential and achieve remarkable things.

Job Description

The Education Program Manager manages all support mechanisms relating to the design, delivery, and performance of professional education and workforce development programs for the Center. This role is responsible for ensuring a portfolio of programs are monitored and tracked from concept through execution, ensuring alignment with market demand, organizational strategy, and revenue goals. The position works cross-functionally with faculty, partners, and clients.

30% - Marketing and Enrollment Strategy

Execute marketing plans for the Center programs and offerings.
Draft and format marketing materials, including program descriptions, promotional emails, and social media content.
Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies to achieve enrollment and revenue targets
Produce marketing materials including social media images, website graphics, and promotional flyers.
Maintain a marketing calendar outlining promotional activities, timelines, and outreach schedules.
Oversee development of marketing assets and messaging aligned to target audiences.
Maintain enrollment tracking (HubSpot) mechanisms for upcoming programs and workshops.
Assist with collecting testimonials, participant feedback, and program success stories for marketing use.
Coordinate communication with registrants including confirmation messages, reminders, and follow-up materials – HubSpot.
Support post-program communications including participant surveys and follow-up engagement opportunities.

30% - Program Management and Delivery

Manage the full lifecycle of professional education programs from design through evaluation, including space logistics, technology needs, and participant communications.
Prepare scopes of work, timelines, and deliverable summaries for professional education and consulting projects.
Maintain the Center’s customer relationship management (CRM) system, including data entry and contact management.
Maintain and update website content related to Center offerings.

25% - Program and Business Development

Lead development of proposals for professional education programs, consulting engagements, and workforce initiatives.
Compile background research, data, and organizational information required for proposal development.

Conduct market analysis to identify new program opportunities and revenue streams.
Develop scopes of work, pricing models, and program structures aligned with CWE strategy.
Track and manage pipeline of opportunities and revenue projections.
Maintain HubSpot tracking system for proposal opportunities, deadlines, and submissions.

15% - Data, Evaluation, and Budget

Use CRM software and program data to monitor performance, enrollment trends, and program effectiveness.
Develop reporting mechanisms and dashboards to increase leadership decision-making
Maintains budgets, transactions, cost centers, payment links through HubSpot, and JRC processes.
Identify opportunities for program improvement and expansion.
Support long-term strategy through data-informed insights.

Position Requirements

A limited amount of in-state travel may be required of this position.
This position may require occasional work outside of its usual schedule, including evening and weekends to attend events.

Required Qualifications

Master's degree in related field OR a bachelor's degree in a related field plus 5 years of related experience.
Three years of experience in program management, professional education, workforce development, or related field.
One year of experience in marketing, enrollment strategy, or stakeholder engagement.
Strong written and verbal communication skills as demonstrated through materials and interview process.

This position requires a formal degree in the cited discipline area(s) to ensure that candidates have advanced knowledge, analytical skills and professional competencies necessary to perform the duties of the position. The level of degree is commonly recognized as the standard qualification for similar roles in the public and private sector, ensuring that the university remains competitive with industry aligned practices, enhances collaboration with external partners, and supports the delivery of services and programs that meet professional and market-driven expectations.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in business administration, Public Administration, or Project Management or related field.
Experience in higher education or professional development environments, as evidenced by application materials.
Experience with CRM systems (HubSpot or similar), as evidenced by application materials.
Experience developing proposals or managing external partnerships, as evidenced by application materials.

Additional Candidate Instructions

In addition to the online application, the following documents are required to be considered for this position:

Cover letter describing how you meet the required and preferred qualifications.
Resume
List of three (3) professional references

Only complete applications will be considered.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Hunt Institute’s mission is to provide unbiased research, technical expertise, and learning opportunities that equip and empower educators and policymakers to drive equitable reforms and become audacious champions for education. Since its establishment in 2001, the organization has emerged as a recognized and credible leader in the movement to transform American public education and a go-to source for reliable, objective, and timely information. The Institute works at the intersection of education policy and politics, supporting state and national officials and empowering them to drive education reform. Its mandate is to inspire and equip elected officials and senior policymakers to make informed decisions that improve the lives of all children. The Institute’s primary audience consists of governors, legislators, and other elected and state-level policymakers.

About The Role

The Hunt Institute is seeking a Senior Program Manager (SPM) to join our State Engagement team. The SPM develops sessions and content for State Legislators Retreats, Hunt State Policy Fellows, and support other Institute work as needed, including conducting research and analysis on relevant policy issues and providing information for reports, policy briefs, primers, and case studies for dissemination. The Senior Program Manager will report directly to the Director of State Engagement. The position is based out of The Hunt Institute’s office in Cary, North Carolina.

What You'll Do

Program Strategy & Execution

Plans, develops, implements, and coordinates Hunt Institute project(s) or program(s).
Manages, and oversees the daily administrative components of program(s)/project(s).
Define program goals, objectives, and success metrics, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities.
Coordinate and communicate with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular program updates and reports.
Manage program budgets, ensuring projects are completed within budgetary constraints.
Create agendas, identify speakers, track registration, coordinate with the events & State Engagement team, and serve as overall manager of assigned Hunt Institute programs and events.
Lead program evaluation and post-program reviews to assess successes, challenges, and lessons learned.

Project Management

Manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet tight deadlines.
Identify and implement improvements to strengthen The Hunt Institute’s support for state early learning education and policy.
Ensure project schedules and timelines facilitate meaningful participation from elected officials.
Provide grant deliverable details regarding impact for grant and funder applications and reports.
Perform all related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

Commitment to the mission and vision of The Hunt Institute, alongside a passion for challenging entrenched systems of educational inequity towards the bettering of public education for all children.
Awareness of key state and national education policy issues.
Exceptional project management skills.
A strong work ethic, with a results-oriented philosophy and personal qualities of trustworthiness, openness, accessibility, kindness, flexibility, and a sense of humor.
Ability to handle multiple assignments and accomplish deadlines; ability to pay attention to accuracy and detail while thinking broadly.
Bachelor’s degree is required.
Minimum three years’ experience.
Excellent interpersonal skills and flexible, responsive work style.
Ability to travel (anticipated 10 – 15%).

Ideal Candidates Will Also Demonstrate

Knowledge of state and national P-16 education policy.
Resourcefulness and good judgment.
Leadership by example.
The value of diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
Integrity/ethics beyond reproach.
Constant seeking to apply best practices.
Exceptional attention to detail, strong project management, and the ability to handle multiple deadlines simultaneously.
Willingness to travel and work outside regular business hours as needed for event schedules.
Willingness to work collaboratively and consider new ideas.
Commitment to The Hunt Institute’s mission, vision, financial growth, and success.

Benefits And Compensation

The Hunt Institute offers competitive compensation and an attractive benefits package, including employer paid health, dental and vision insurance, and a 401(k) plan with an employer matching contribution policy.

We feel passionately about equal pay for equal work, and transparency in compensation is one vehicle to achieve that. The salary recruitment range for this position is $79,240- $87,164

Work Schedule

This position is based out of our office at 5000 Centregreen Way, Suite 150, Cary, NC, 27513. This is a hybrid position requiring on-site presence at our office in Cary, NC, three days per week. The remaining two days may be completed remotely from your home office. Employees are expected on-site on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays to collaborate on team projects and attend strategic planning meetings. Occasional evenings and weekends may be required.

Office hours: 8:30am-5:00pm

Equal Employment Opportunity

At The Hunt Institute, Equal Employment Opportunity is our commitment and goal. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status or any other protected status designated by federal, state or local law. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self-identify when applying. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a reference check and background investigation.
